## Read empirical data

```{r}
data_emp <- read_parquet(here("data", "analysis-data", "liqplat_analysis_data_long.parquet"))

fig_emp <- data_emp |>
  mutate(
        week = ceiling(day / 7),
        surv_time = ceiling(surv_time / 7),
    ) |>
    group_by(id, week) |>
    mutate(
        y_taooh = factor(max(y_taooh), levels = 1:5)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(id, week, tx, y = y_taooh) |>
    distinct() |>
    filter(week > 0) |>
    group_by(id) |>
    complete(week = 1:26) |>
    arrange(id, week) |>
    fill(c(tx, y), .direction = "down") |>
    markov.misc::plot_sops(time_var = "week", linetype_var = "tx", facet_var = NULL, geom = "line") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 26, by = 4)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = "Empirical state occupancy probabilities")

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_emp_sops.svg"),
  plot = fig_emp,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

fig_emp2 <- data_emp |>
  mutate(
        week = ceiling(day / 7),
        surv_time = ceiling(surv_time / 7),
        tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("UC", "SAT"))
    ) |>
    group_by(id, week) |>
    mutate(
        y_taooh = factor(max(y_taooh), levels = 1:5)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(id, week, tx, y = y_taooh) |>
    distinct() |>
    filter(week > 0) |>
    group_by(id) |>
    complete(week = 1:26) |>
    arrange(id, week) |>
    fill(c(tx, y), .direction = "down") |>
    markov.misc::plot_sops(time_var = "week", linetype_var = "tx", facet_var = "tx", geom = "bar") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = "Empirical state occupancy probabilities")

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_emp_sops_stacked.svg"),
  plot = fig_emp2,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(duckdb)

# Create a temporary on-disk database
db_path <- here("taooh_scratch.duckdb")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = db_path)

# Process each imputation separately and aggregate progressively
message("Processing imputations...")
sop_list <- vector("list", m)

for (imp_idx in 1:m) {
  message(glue::glue("Processing imputation {imp_idx} of {m}"))

  # Get normalized paths
  dir_0 <- normalizePath(here(sop_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_0"), winslash = "/")
  dir_1 <- normalizePath(here(sop_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_1"), winslash = "/")

  # Process each arm separately and aggregate immediately
  # This reduces memory by averaging over covariate patterns before combining
  query <- glue::glue("
    SELECT
      state,
      time,
      draw,
      tx,
      {imp_idx} as imp,
      AVG(probability) as sop
    FROM (
      SELECT state, time, draw, 0 as tx, probability FROM read_parquet('{dir_0}/*.parquet')
      UNION ALL
      SELECT state, time, draw, 1 as tx, probability FROM read_parquet('{dir_1}/*.parquet')
    )
    GROUP BY state, time, draw, tx
  ")

  # Get aggregated data for this imputation
  sop_list[[imp_idx]] <- dbGetQuery(con, query) |> as_tibble()
}

# Combine all imputations
message("Combining results...")
sop_summary <- rbindlist(sop_list)

# Clean up
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
duckdb::duckdb_shutdown(duckdb::duckdb())  # Fully release file locks
if (file.exists(db_path)) file.remove(db_path)

# Format for plotting
setDT(sop_summary)
sop_summary[, state := as.factor(state)]
sop_summary[, tx := factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("UC", "SAT"))]
```

## Plotting

### Marginalized SOPs

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
fig_marginalized <-
  sop_summary |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = time, y = sop) +
  stat_lineribbon(
    aes(fill = state, linetype = tx),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.4,
    .width = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 26, by = 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Study Week",
    y = "SOP",
    subtitle = "Marginalized state occupancy probabilities",
    fill = "State",
    linetype = "Group"
  )

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_marginalized_sops.svg"),
  plot = fig_marginalized,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_marginalized_sops.png"),
  plot = fig_marginalized,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Primary Estimand

### Difference in Weeks  Alive and Out of Hospital

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

posterior <- sop_summary |>
  filter(state == "1") |>
  group_by(tx, draw, imp) |>
  summarise(mean_weeks = sum(sop), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = mean_weeks, names_prefix = "tx_") |>
  mutate(difference = tx_SAT - tx_UC)

# Summary statistics
posterior_summary <- posterior |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(difference),
    median = median(difference),
    sd = sd(difference),
    q025 = quantile(difference, 0.025),
    q975 = quantile(difference, 0.975),
    p_benefit = mean(difference > 0)
  )

posterior_summary
```

Table

```{r}
state_tbl <- sop_summary |>
  group_by(state, tx, draw, imp) |>
  summarise(
    weeks = sum(sop),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tx,
    values_from = weeks,
    names_prefix = "tx_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = tx_SAT - tx_UC
  ) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(
    UC_mean = mean(tx_UC),
    UC_sd = sd(tx_UC),
    UC_median = median(tx_UC),
    UC_lower = quantile(tx_UC, 0.025),
    UC_upper = quantile(tx_UC, 0.975),

    SAT_mean = mean(tx_SAT),
    SAT_sd = sd(tx_SAT),
    SAT_median = median(tx_SAT),
    SAT_lower = quantile(tx_SAT, 0.025),
    SAT_upper = quantile(tx_SAT, 0.975),

    diff_mean = mean(difference),
    diff_sd = sd(difference),
    diff_median = median(difference),
    diff_lower = quantile(difference, 0.025),
    diff_upper = quantile(difference, 0.975),

    p_benefit = mean(difference > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    state = case_match(
      as.character(state),
      "1" ~ "Out of hospital",
      "2" ~ "Planned hospitalization",
      "3" ~ "Emergency room visit",
      "4" ~ "Unplanned hospitalization",
      "5" ~ "Death"
    ),
    `UC Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", UC_mean, UC_sd),
    `UC Median [95%% CrI]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", UC_median, UC_lower, UC_upper),
    `SAT Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", SAT_mean, SAT_sd),
    `SAT Median [95%% CrI]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", SAT_median, SAT_lower, SAT_upper),
    `SAT - UC Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", diff_mean, diff_sd),
    `SAT - UC Median [95%% CrI]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", diff_median, diff_lower, diff_upper),
    `Posterior Pr(SAT > UC)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * p_benefit),
    .keep = "none"
  )

state_tbl

write_parquet(state_tbl, here("0-main-analysis", "TAOOH", "results", "taooh_estimands.parquet"))
```

### Posterior Distribution Plot (Difference with Color-Coded Regions)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

plot_posterior_colored <- posterior |>
  ggplot(aes(x = difference)) +
  stat_halfeye(aes(fill = after_stat(x > 0))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#2ca066ff", "FALSE" = "grey"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Benefit (SAT > UC)", "FALSE" = "Harm (SAT ≤ UC)")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = bquote(paste("Difference in Weeks spent Alive and Out of Hospital")),
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
```

### Posterior Distribution by Group

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# Prepare data for group-specific posteriors
posterior_by_group <- posterior |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tx_UC, tx_SAT),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "weeks",
    names_prefix = "tx_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("SAT", "UC"),
                   labels = c("Single-Arm Trial", "Usual Care"))
  )

# Define colors matching table-1
group_colors <- c("Single-Arm Trial" = "#009e73", "Usual Care" = "#56b4e9")

plot_posterior_by_group <- posterior_by_group |>
  ggplot(aes(x = weeks, fill = group, color = group)) +
  stat_halfeye(
    slab_alpha = 0.2,     # Faint density
    interval_alpha = 0.9, # Solid intervals
    point_alpha = 1.0,    # Solid point estimate
    linewidth = 1.2,
    .width = 0.95) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Weeks Alive and Out of Hospital",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Group",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_posterior_by_group.svg"),
  plot = plot_posterior_by_group,
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "taooh_posterior_by_group.png"),
  plot = plot_posterior_by_group,
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
